description: This Java class manages JWT-based single sign-on authentication for OFBiz applications, including token creation, validation, and user login handling.
published: createJwt (full overload with salt and expireTime)

classes.name: JWTManager
classes.description: Manages JWT token creation, validation, and user login processes for OFBiz applications, supporting single sign-on via JWT.

methods.name: checkJWTLogin
methods.description: Performs JWT-based SSO login check, retrieves user info from token, and initiates login session.

methods.name: getJWTKey
methods.description: Retrieves the JWT secret key from properties or database, optionally with salt.

methods.name: getAuthenticationToken
methods.description: Authenticates user via username/password and generates a JWT token.

methods.name: getHeaderAuthBearerToken
methods.description: Extracts JWT token from Authorization header if in Bearer format.

methods.name: validateToken
methods.description: Validates a JWT token using a secret key and returns claims or error.

methods.name: validateToken (overload with delegator)
methods.description: Validates a JWT token with key derived from delegator and salt.

methods.name: createJwt
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with claims and default expiration time.

methods.name: createJwt (overload with claims and expireTime)
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with specified claims and expiration time.

methods.name: createJwt (full overload with salt and expireTime)
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with claims, optional salt, and expiration time.

methods.name: checkTenant
methods.description: Verifies tenant context for multi-tenant setups and adjusts session context.

methods.name: storeUserlogin
methods.description: Stores user login info in database, logs errors if fails.

methods.name: getUserlogin
methods.description: Retrieves user login record from database based on JWT claim.

methods.name: validateJwtToken
methods.description: Validates JWT token and logs warning if invalid.
